title: Fill the Backpack
statement:
A backpack holds at most `W` kilograms. There are `n` items, each with a weight and a value, and each item can be taken at most once. Find the largest total value that fits in the backpack.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `W`. Each of the next `n` lines contains the weight and value of one item.

## Output
Print the largest total value.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100`
- `1 <= W <= 5000`
- `1 <= weight <= 5000`
- `1 <= value <= 10^6`
